critique.rationale: Confirmed, warm, time-boxed reunion; X leads with the who-and-where in one line. Feud framing deliberately left out. Photo is a generic Taylor tile, not from the game, so media scores 3.

why: Same-day news: Taylor brought Karlie Kloss to the Chiefs-Jets game at Arrowhead on Sun 11-08 (intake #6713, confirmed by People via Yahoo and Just Jared). takes 11-09 heartbeat; heartbeat → 11-10. Photo is the reserved eventPhoto (Eras Tour, not the game); copy never claims it is from Arrowhead. X written first; hook = the artifact (karlie in the suite).
